subject: Money
title: Medici Banking Dynasty
description: A short lesson to help you apply Medici Banking Dynasty.

hook.text: The Medici Bank in Florence invented double-entry bookkeeping and modern branch banking in the 1400s.

buildup.text: Giovanni de' Medici opened branches across Europe. Each branch operated semi-independently with local managers.

discovery.text: They disguised interest as 'exchange fees' to avoid the Church's ban on usury. Same profit, different label.

twist.text: Medici wealth funded the Renaissance. Botticelli, Michelangelo, and Leonardo all depended on banker patrons.

climax.text: A banking family reshaped Western civilization. Money didn't just buy art—it built an entire cultural era.

punchline.text: Behind every Renaissance, a bank balance.

quiz.question: How did the Medici avoid usury laws?
